sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI's announcement gives the standard input and output price for Grok 2 Vision models; it does not state cached-token pricing or an effective date.
xAI release notes identify cached prompts as an API capability, but this passage does not establish Grok 2 Vision cache prices or when a particular rate applied.

notes: The provider's announcement supports the unchanged $2/$10 standard rates, but available primary-source material does not establish whether the newly recorded cache_read/cache_write values were official Grok 2 Vision rates throughout the earlier period or became effective later. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint was unavailable from this environment, so no snapshot pair could be checked; no effective date or official previous cache rate can be stated.
